MemoryConfigs.Description: Hook at RVA 3C65B6. Original 19 bytes are: imul ecx,[r14]; imul ecx (with 0x51EB851F); sar edx,5; mov eax,edx; shr eax,1Fh; add edx,eax; add [r14],edx. MemoryConfigs.Description: In SUNITRESIST_GetResist sub_140324FF0 (the per-element effective-resistance computer called by the damage applier sub_1403253D0), the negative-resist clamp at RVA 3250DE is 'mov eax, 0xFFFFFF9C (-100); cmp ebx,eax (3B D8); cmovg eax,ebx (0F 4F C3)' where ebx = accumulated resist. eax is preloaded with the floor (-100) and cmovg keeps it unless the real resist is greater (less negative), so any resist <= -100 returns exactly -100. Scope: lower clamp only; the upper cap (maxresist, default 75 / hard ceiling 95) is a separate path at RVA 3250F1 onward and is unaffected.

With the id non-zero from the first tick the wildcard never triggers and no other aura's event is ever removed.
